open_instrument_follow_ups.finding: An artifact's top-level convenience tables (ext_per_family, ext_correct) are not bound to the per-example vectors. The verdict republishes its own recomputation and the reader voids if a banked PER-ARM reading disagrees with it, so a verdict cannot be corrupted this way - but the artifact is the banked evidence, and a fabricated top-level table sits beside a correct verdict undetected. Demonstrated by the 0021 pre-freeze review on a control artifact that passed with all eight families' real_model per-family readings set to 0.99.
